senses.gloss: 1. उप-√ यज् P. Ā. -यजति, -ते, to sacrifice in addition to, TS.; ŚBr.; KātyŚr.; PārGṛ. Comm. on VS. vi, 21.
2. उप-य॑ज् ट्, f. (Pāṇ. iii, 2, 73) N. of eleven additional formulas at an animal sacrifice (enumerated in VS. vi, 21), TS.; MaitrS.; ŚBr.
उप-यष्टृ॑ ता, m. the priest who utters the above formulas, ŚBr. iii, 8, 5, 5.
1. उप-याज (for 2. see s.v.), m. = 2. उपय॑ज्, AitBr. ii, 18, 8; Kāś. on Pāṇ. vii, 3, 62.
2. उप-याज (for 1. See उप-√ यज्) m. N. of a younger brother of Yāja, MBh.
1. उप-√ यत् Ā. -यतते, to befall, ŚBr. viii, 5, 1, 7.
उप-यत् See उपे॑.
2. उप-यत् mfn. (for 1. See s.v.) going near, approaching &c.
flowing into, attached, Kir. vi, 16 (said of rivers and female friends)
entering any state, serving for, Kir. vi, 26.
उप-√ यन्त्र् P.
उप-यन्त्रित mfn. solicited or compelled to do anything, allured, Mn. xi, 177 (erroneous for उप-म˚, BRD.)
उप-यन्त्र n. a minor or secondary instrument or implement (esp. in surg.), Suśr.
a secondary application of any kind (as cautery, escharotics &c.), W.
उप-यन्तृ m. a husband, Ragh. vii, 1; Kum.
उप-यम m. (Pāṇ. iii, 3, 63) appropriation, taking possession of
marrying, marriage, Sāh.
kindling a fire, (कन्याग्न्य्-उपयम, taking a wife and kindling the domestic fire, Gaut. xviii, 18)
a support, stay, ĀpŚr. xv, 9, 10.
उप-याम॑ अम्, m. (Pāṇ. iii, 3, 63) a particular vessel for ladling out
a ladle (used at sacrifices), VS. vii, 4, &c.
N. of a deity, VS. xxv, 2
N. of the verses (VS. vii, 4 seqq.) uttered in ladling out the Soma juice, ŚBr.; KātyŚr.
marrying, marriage, L.
उप-यमन mfn. serving as support (as grass), PārGṛ.
उप-यमन n. a support, stay, ĀśvŚr.
the taking a wife, marrying, Pāṇ.
sleeping with (a woman), Kād.
उप-यमनी f. (उप-य॑मनि) any support (of stone, clay, gravel &c. for holding fire-wood), ŚBr. iii, 5, 2, 1; KātyŚr.
a ladle (used at sacrifices), ŚBr.; AitBr.; KātyŚr.
उप-याम—वत् mfn. furnished with a ladle g. बलादि, Pāṇ. v, 2, 136.
उपयामिन् mfn. (fr. उप-याम, g. बलादि, Pāṇ. v, 2, 136), furnished with a ladle.
उपाय &c. See p. 215, col. 2.
उपाय m. coming near, approach, arrival, Bhartṛ.
that by which one reaches one's aim, a means or expedient (of any kind), way, stratagem, craft, artifice, MBh.; Mn.; Yājñ.; Pañcat. &c.
(esp.) a means of success against an enemy (four are usually enumerated, sowing dissension, negotiation, bribery, and open assault)
joining in or accompanying (in singing), ŚāṅkhŚr.

उपा-√ या P. -याति, to come near or towards, approach, RV.; MBh.; BhP.; Kathās. &c.;
to come into any state or condition, undergo, MārkP.; Kir.
उप-यात mfn. approached, visited, frequented
one who has approached or come near
one who has obtained
approached sexually (as a woman)
उप-यात n. arrival.
उपा-यात mfn. approached
उपा-यात n. arrival.
उप-यान n. coming near, approach, arrival, R.; Kum.; Sāh.
उपा॑यन अम्, n. the act of coming near, approach, RV. ii, 28, 2
going to a teacher, becoming a pupil, initiation, ŚBr. xiv; Āp. i, 1, 5
engaging (in any religious observance), undertaking, ŚBr. xi; KātyŚr.
an offer, present, gift, MBh.; BhP.; Śak. &c.
उप-यापन n. the act of causing to come near, leading near, BhP.
उप-यायिन् mfn. coming towards, approaching, R.
उप-√ याच्
उप-याचक mfn. one who asks, begging, soliciting, L.
उप-याचन n. the act of soliciting, approaching with a request or prayer, R.
उप-याचित mfn. requested
solicited, Ragh. xiii, 53; Kād.
asked for, begged, VarBṛS.; Sarvad. &c.
उप-याचित n. a prayer, request
a gift or oblation offered to deities for the fulfilment of a prayer or work, Pañcat.; Kathās.
उपयाचितक n. a prayer, request, L.
उपा-√ युज् P. (1. sg. -युनज्मि) to put to, harness, RV. iii, 35, 2.
उप-युक्त mfn. enjoyed, eaten, consumed, MBh.; R.
employed, applicable
suitable, fit, appropriate, useful, Kathās.; Rājat.; Prab. &c.
proper, right
serviceable
worthy, Śak.; Hit.; Pat. &c.
उप-युयुक्षु mfn. (fr. the Desid.), about to employ or apply, Suśr.
उप-योक्तव्य mfn. to be employed
to be enjoyed, MBh.
उप-योक्तृ mfn. one who employs
one who enjoys (food), Car.
उप-योग m. employment, use, application, MBh.; Suśr.; Prab.
(उपयोगं-√ गम् or √ व्रज्, to be employed, Kum.; Śārṅg.)
enjoyment, consuming, taking, Suśr.
any act tending to a desired object
an engagement, compact, agreement, Pāṇ. i, 4, 29
use, fitness
acquisition (of knowledge), Gaut. vii, 1
good conduct, observing established practices, L.
calculation (˚गं √ कृ ‘to calculate’), HPariś.
उपयोगिन् mfn. serving for use or application, suitable, fit, useful, convenient, Kathās.; Sāh. &c.
appropriate
favourable, propitious
(ifc.) using, employing, Daś.
touching, in contact with, L.

उपयोगि-ता, f. or उपयोगि-त्व, n. the state of being applicable;
 usefulness, suitableness, Naiṣ.; Kathās.

उपयोगि-ता, f. or उपयोगि-त्व, n. the state of being applicable;
 usefulness, suitableness, Naiṣ.; Kathās.
उप-योग्य mfn. to be employed or used, Bālar.
उप-योजन n. the act of harnessing (a horse by the side of another), AitBr. v, 30, 6
a team, Nir.
उप-योज्य mfn. to be employed or used or applied, Suśr.
उप-युत m. N. of a king, VP.
उप-योषम् ind. v.l. for उप-जोषम्, q.v.
उपाय-कौशल्य n. skill in the choice of means, SaddhP.
उपाय—चतुष्टय n. the above four expedients against an enemy, Hit. &c.
उपाय—चिन्ता f. devising an expedient, thinking of a resource.
उपाय—ज्ञ mfn. knowing or fertile in expedients, contriving, provident.
उपाय—तस् ind. by some means or expedient, in a clever way, Kathās.
उपाय—तुरीय n. ‘the fourth means’, violence, Pañcat.
उपाय—त्व n. the state of being provided with means.
उपाय—योग m. application of means or combination of expedients.
उपाय—वत् mfn. (any Stobha q.v.) marked by the joining in or accompaniment (of other Stobhas), Lāṭy. vii, 6, 5.
उपाय—श्रीभद्र m. N. of a Buddhist student.
उपायाक्षेप m. (in rhet.) deprecatory speech making mention of the remedy (against the evil deprecated), Kāvyād. ii, 151 seq.
उपायान्तर n. ‘another means’, a remedy.
उपायोपेय means and object, Mālav.

उपायनी-√ कृ to offer as a present, Daś.;
to communicate respectfully, Prasannar. 10, 3.
उपायनी—कृत mfn. offered as a present, Kathās.
उपायिन् mfn. going near, one who approaches, KātyŚr. iii
one who reaches, RāmatUp.
approaching sexually, KātyŚr.
expert in the use of means, L.
उपायु॑ mfn. approaching, TS. i, 1, 1, 1; ŚBr. i; KātyŚr.
